title: KUBE_PROXY_NFTABLES_SKIP_KERNEL_VERSION_CHECK now needs a non-empty value

detection.reason: container environment variable NAMES are not in the collected projection (only hasEnvApiRefs), so an env var set on the kube-proxy DaemonSet cannot be read

quote: The kernel version check is now skipped only when this variable is explicitly set to a non-empty value.
remediation: Only matters if you set this variable to skip the kernel check. An empty value used to skip the check and now does not, so a node below the kernel floor that used to start will stop starting. Set it to a non-empty value, or raise the kernel.
verifyCommand: kubectl -n kube-system get ds -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select(.metadata.name | startswith("kube-proxy")) | .spec.template.spec.containers[].env[]? | select(.name == "KUBE_PROXY_NFTABLES_SKIP_KERNEL_VERSION_CHECK") | .name + "=" + (.value // "")'  # an empty value no longer skips the kernel check
